Title: RubyOnRails Developer 
 Location: Provo, Utah 
 Duration: 6 month contract-to-hire 
 Interview Process: SKYPE 
 Need GC,USC,GC-EAD,TN 
 Top Skills: 
 • 2-4+ years of recent, relevant RubyOnRails development experience 
 • AWS (Cloud)-based experience 
 • Postgres database exposure 
 • Good knowledge of data management issues including storage, secure transmission, encryption and transactions
 • PLUS: experience with continuous deployment
 • PLUS: experience with automated testing concepts 
 Job Summary: They are a very team oriented environment that is very fast paced. They are looking for someone who is a self-starter and can come in and take charge on this project. They need someone who can read through the existing code base and make the necessary changes for the web portal to operate correctly. Therefore this person needs to be very technical and have a strong ability to interact with other developers and team members.


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 468 0398.
